objs.name: policy
objs.description: A company-wide regulation and process at strategic level (e.g. code of conduct, travel expenses policy, ICS policy, process and organizational structure).

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document describing locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process as part of an effective governance system.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: A document describing specific procedures within a framework or process sequence with details and responsible persons to achieve an objective.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document describing detailed work steps, test instructions and compliance criteria for sub-processes, typically relevant for specific departments.

objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact subject to the P&R Management system, encompassing all document types and levels.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with its main document and subject to the same versioning and release lifecycle.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document supplement not subject to the main document's release cycle, released directly and without version impact on the main document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposed modification to an existing document created by authors without affecting the document's version history until implemented.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check whether a document remains valid at the end of its validity period.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has additional validity.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person participating in the P&R Management system with assigned roles and authorizations.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned collectively to documents and distribution lists.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A user group that retains read access to archived documents while other authorizations are revoked.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups or persons assigned to a document for notification and acknowledgement purposes.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: A translated version of a released document requiring its own review and release workflow.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A separate instance in a multi-client system within which documents have visibility and applicability.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to document their approval in the release process.

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: A complete record of document changes, versioning, and approval actions for traceability.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined structure or format available for selection when creating new documents of a specific type.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach a new information object to the system with selection of document type, template, and initial properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the content of a document using the embedded editing client based on the source format.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Define and edit standardized and customer-specific metadata and attributes of a document grouped in categories.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Attach an external document or file to a newly created document object.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the edited document to PDF format for web display and release.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Grant document-specific read and change rights to user groups or individual users.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Designate specific users as author, co-author, reviewer, or releaser for the document release process.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Add supplementary information to a document without triggering versioning or release requirements.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled document supplement that is released with the main document and triggers versioning.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archival, to be archived upon next version release of the main document.

evts.name: initiate_release_process
evts.description: Start the three-step workflow consisting of Creator signature, Review, and Release steps.

evts.name: sign_document_creation
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step to confirm creation.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects by assigned reviewers.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and finalize a document for distribution, triggered by at least one assigned releaser.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Decline a document in review or release step, terminating the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document automatically visible to assigned readers.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Automatically generate a new version of a released document when content or properties are modified.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Propose a modification to a document without affecting its content or version history until implementation.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Accept a change proposal and create a new document version incorporating the proposed amendments.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Mark a change proposal as completed after the author has documented the editing.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System-generated request created when a document reaches 30 days before its validity expiration.

evts.name: extend_document_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity for a document, updating the 'Valid until' date by the standard period.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Update a released document with content or property changes, creating a new version in editing status.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Request to invalidate a document that has no additional validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare a document and its attachments invalid and archive them, revoking authorizations except for archive group.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: End the validity extension workflow and delete the associated request upon document override or new version release.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated document during the archiving period.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate an invalidated document and create a new version with retained metadata and reactivated attachments.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Send email notification to assigned user groups and persons when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Require assigned users to actively confirm receipt and understanding of a document upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient actively confirms receipt and understanding of a distributed document via workflow.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate the content of a released document into another language for language-dependent display.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check and approve the translated version of a document by assigned participants.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Finalize and publish a translated document version for authorized readers in the corresponding language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Define which clients in a multi-client system have visibility to a specific document.
